p: commanded the people: As God's minister and charged with the same.
And thou shalt write upon them: God would have his law set up in the borders of the land of Canaan, that all that looked on it might know that the land was dedicated to his service.
iron tool upon them: The altar should not be curiously wrought, because it would continue but for a time: for God would have only one altar in Judah.
very plainly: That everyone may well read it, and understand it.
shalt therefore obey the voice of: This condition has bound you to it, that if you will be his people, you must keep his laws.
curse: Signifying, that if they would not obey God out of love, they would be made to obey out of fear.
image: Under this he contains all the corruptions of God's service, and the transgression of the first table.
setteth light by his father or: Or, condemns; and this applies to the second table.
landmark: He condemns all injuries and extortions.
blind to wander out of the: Meaning, that does not help and counsel his neighbour.
skirt: In committing wickedness against him, Le 20:11, De 22:30, Eze 22:10
mother in law: Meaning, his wife's mother.
secretly: For God that sees in secret, will avenge it.
